title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love Manga Ends with 7th Volume
content: Kadokawa is listing the seventh compiled book volume of Momose Hanada 's manga adaptation of Harunadon 's Even a Replica Can Fall in Love ( Replica Datte, Koi o Suru ) novel series as its final volume. Kadokawa will ship the final volume on October 27.
author: ANN

title: You and I are Polar Opposites 2nd Season Anime's 12th Episode Airs on September 27
content: Animation studio Lapin Track announced on Sunday that the 24th episode of the You and I Are Polar Opposites ( Seihantaina Kimi to Boku ) anime (the 12th episode of the show's second season) will air on September 27, and the show is taking a break next week.
author: ANN

title: Gundam RG XARX-ZERO Anime 'Launches' in N. America, Japan in April 2027
content: The official website for the Mobile Suit Gundam RG XARX-ZERO anime revealed on Monday that the anime will "launch" in North America and Japan in April 2027. The anime's Japanese website uses the term "hōsō" (broadcast) that is often used for airing on television.
author: ANN

title: The World's Strongest Witch Novels Listed to End in 6th Volume
content: Amazon Japan is listing the sixth volume of Mochimaru Sakaki 's The World's Strongest Witch light novel series as the final one. The volume will ship on October 7. title: BanG Dream! Our Notes Mobile Game Streams New Trailer
content: The staff for BanG Dream! Our Notes — bilibili Game, Bushiroad Games, and FROMTOKYO 's new mobile game from the BanG Dream! franchise — presented a new trailer on Sunday to introduce the different groups. In BanG Dream! Our Notes , players will be thrown into the stories of MyGO!!!!!
author: ANN

title: Otomate Brand Unveils Hakuōki Shinkai Kiwame, Other New Game Releases
content: During its " Otomate Party 2026" event on Sunday, Ideal Factory's Otomate brand unveiled Hakuōki Shinkai Kiwame . Otomate describes the release as a "compilation of the Hakuōki " otome game franchise for Nintendo Switch 2. Hakuōki Shinkai Kiwame is one of the titles commemorating Otomate 's 20th anniversary in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Kazuki Takahashi's Art Exhibit Gets Special Animated Yu-Gi-Oh! Video
content: The official YouTube channel for the Yu-Gi-Oh! franchise began streaming a special animated video on Monday. The video promotes the " YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS" art exhibit for the late Yu-Gi-Oh! creator Kazuki Takahashi . The art exhibit will take place at Creative Museum Tokyo from December 12, 2026 to February 21, 2027.
author: ANN

title: 'Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite' Creator Announces Two New Manga
content: Uoto , the creator of Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite ( Orb: On the Movements of the Earth ), announced two new manga on their X (formerly Twitter) account on Friday and Saturday. The first title, Hallucination Meat , is expected to begin in Shogakukan's Weekly Big Comic Spirits within this year.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Solo Leveling
content: Solo Leveling has become one of the defining anime of the modern era, with two seasons released back-to-back in 2024 and 2025. It set records that even surpassed some of the longest-running anime of all time, including One Piece , on Crunchyroll by becoming the highest-rated anime of all time .
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of 2026 Just Proved It Deserves Anime of the Year With Its Perfect Ending
content: The summer season of 2026 is almost at an end, meaning the anime that started this season are also coming to an end, and the first to conclude was arguably the darkest anime of 2026 that has aired on Crunchyroll so far this year.
